title: Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available
contentSnippet: Public traffic to private origins, with WAF, bot management, caching, and Workers, is now available to every customer with Cloudflare One connectivity.

title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
contentSnippet: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

title: Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft
contentSnippet:
As Microsoft Threat Intelligence continues to track how threat actors operationalize AI to increase the speed and efficiency of attacks, we’ve identified North Korean threat actors expanding their use of AI with varying levels of adoption. This blog breaks down how North Korean threat actors are utilizing AI across their operations, reflecting a broader trend of threat actors incorporating AI into their attack chains.
The post Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog.
